core.title: Design Hardware 73 Door Closer with Parallel Arm

text.description_html:
Design Hardware 73 Door Closer

Design Hardware offers you solutions proven to fit every application from the heaviest use to the most prestigious and even the aesthetically pleasing. You will find their high quality products in residential and commercial projects around the world.

73 Design Hardware Specs:

  • UL Listed, Non Handed.
  • Size 3, for use on 100 -145 lb door.
  • Aluminum and Dark Bronze painted finishes.
  • Latch Speed & Sweep Controls.
  • Closer body 2 3/8" projection.
  • Includes Wood and Machine screw fasteners.
  • Parallel Arm Bracket included
